title: Aqueous solution of biogenic carboxylic acids as sustainable catalysts and green reaction media for the high-yielding synthesis of Biginelli adducts, Hantzsch esters, and substituted pyridines
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39050-39060
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07772E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Poornachandra Shamanna Prabhakar, Jitendra Sahoo, Ibrahim A. Alnaser, Asiful H. Seikh, Mohammad Rezaul Karim, Saikat Dutta
Biginelli adducts and Hantzsch esters are produced from substituted benzaldehydes using gluconic acid aqueous solution (GAAS) as a sustainable catalyst and reaction medium. A one-pot, two-step synthesis of substituted pyridines is also reported.
